options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the role. If not specified, the assigned description is not changed.

options.name: name
options.description: A name used to identify the role.

options.name: node_identities
options.description: List of node identities to attach to the role. If not specified, any node identities currently assigned are not changed. If the parameter is an empty array (V([])), any node identities assigned are unassigned.

options.name: policies
options.description: List of policies to attach to the role. Each policy is a dict. If the parameter is left blank, any policies currently assigned are not changed. Any empty array (V([])) clears any policies previously set.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the consul agent is running.

options.name: scheme
options.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to V(http) and can be set to V(https) for secure connections.

options.name: service_identities
options.description: List of service identities to attach to the role. If not specified, any service identities currently assigned are not changed. If the parameter is an empty array (V([])), any node identities assigned are unassigned.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the role should be present or absent.

options.name: templated_policies
options.description: The list of templated policies that should be applied to the role.

options.name: token
options.description: The token to use for authorization.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent.
